subject: [PATCH v3 01/12] mm/khugepaged: drop redundant mm_struct pin in madvise_collapse()

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch removes an unnecessary mmgrab() reference in the madvise_collapse() function, which is already holding a valid mm_users reference. The redundant mmgrab() was being held across the work of madvise_collapse(), but since all callers to this function already hold a valid reference to the mm_struct, it can be safely dropped. This patch simplifies the code and reduces unnecessary memory management.
